heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Is Laravel good for large applications?
items.answer: Yes. With the right architecture, Laravel scales to demanding, high-traffic applications.

items.question: Can you build an API with Laravel?
items.answer: Yes. Laravel is excellent for APIs that serve mobile and web clients.

items.question: Do you write automated tests?
items.answer: Yes. We include automated testing for critical features.

items.question: How long does laravel development take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
